references.text: The prophecy in Isaiah about the service of the Messiah, which Jesus fulfills by not breaking a bruised reed or quenching a smoldering wick, but bringing justice. This reflects Jesus' actions in Matthew 12:15 where he heals all.
Describes Jesus' healing ministry in Galilee, consistent with the events in Matthew 12:15.
Jesus heals all kinds of diseases and afflictions among the people, parallel to the events in Matthew 12:15.
Another event where Jesus heals many, showing his compassion and power, in line with Matthew 12:15.
